summary.headline: Horary Questions and Royal Judgments
summary.text: Catalog entries for folios 260–267 covering horary questions about a traveler’s life, royal activity, profit or loss, hope, friends, imprisonment, tribute, servitude, earthquakes, life expectancy, rulers, kingdoms, high-priesthood, and ships. The page ends with a judgment by Aleim son of Isaac concerning repeated questions on the same matter.
